options.instructions:
You are a senior tech recruiter.

Write a LinkedIn outreach message that MUST follow this exact format and rhythm:

FORMAT (exactly 5 short paragraphs):
1) "Hi {FirstName},"
2) "I came across your profile and noticed {specific observation from headline}."
3) "I’m hiring at Tayana Academy for a {ROLE} role (remote) focused on {2-3 relevant technologies}."
4) "{One reason their background fits in 1 sentence}."
5) "Would you be open to a quick chat to explore this further?"

STYLE RULES:
- Keep each paragraph 1 sentence only (except paragraph 2 can be 2 sentences max).
- Total length: under 120 words.
- No emojis.
- No buzzwords or clichés.
- No bold, no links.
- Sound natural and conversational, like the example.
- If graduation year/college is not clearly present in the headline, DO NOT invent it.

ROLE CHOICE:
Pick ONE role based on the profile:
- AI-Full Stack Developer
- AI-Automation Engineering

Output ONLY the message text.

parameters.content:
# **LinkedIn – Accepted Connection → First Outreach Automation**

## This workflow automatically sends a personalized first LinkedIn message when a connection request is accepted.

It:
• Detects accepted connection via Unipile webhook
• Updates Nebula CRM
• Waits naturally (human-like delay)
• Fetches LinkedIn profile details
• Generates AI-personalized outreach
• Sends message via Unipile
• Updates CRM with message status

Fully automated. No manual follow-up required.

## Phase 1 – Detection & CRM Update

• Receives webhook from Unipile when connection is accepted
• Validates event type (new_relation)
• Marks learner as “Connection Accepted” in Nebula
• Stores provider ID for further actions

Purpose: Ensure CRM is always in sync with LinkedIn status.

## Phase 2 – AI Personalization EngineUpdate

• Prevents duplicate first message
• Normalizes webhook data
• Waits 120–180 seconds (human-like behavior)
• Fetches live LinkedIn profile details
• Uses AI to generate personalized outreach

Message Style:
• Under 120 words
• Human tone
• Profile-specific reference
• Clear call-to-action
• Mentions Tayana Academy

Purpose: Send natural, relevant, high-conversion outreach.

## Phase 3 – Message Dispatch & Tracking


• Sends AI-generated message from correct LinkedIn account
• Confirms successful delivery
• Updates CRM with:

* firstMessageSent = true
* message content
* timestamp

Purpose:
Full tracking, auditability, and prevention of duplicate outreach.

## ⚙️  Important Notes

• Only triggers on accepted connections
• Never sends duplicate first message
• Includes natural delay to reduce automation risk
• Uses live profile data for personalization
• CRM is source of truth for message state
